text: dsh-skills-bridge（DSH 插件）：将 Claude Code 技能目录接入 DeepSeek Harness。它注册 SkillProvider，扫描默认或自定义目录中的 SKILL.md，将 frontmatter 转成 DSH 技能字段，并保留额外元数据。目录展示技能摘要、调用规则和正文；默认监听文件变化并刷新。适合希望在 DSH 复用 Claude 技能库的用户。无需 API Key 或外部账号。

dsh-skills-bridge mounts Claude Code skills in DSH. Its SkillProvider scans SKILL.md files in default or configured directories, maps frontmatter, preserves extra metadata, and refreshes the catalog on file changes. Reuse Claude skills in DSH without an API key or external account.

dsh-skills-bridge 的功能「扫描技能目录」：SkillProvider 扫描配置目录及默认技能根目录，将含有效 SKILL.md 的子目录列为候选；目录会去重并略过隐藏项。
dsh-skills-bridge 的功能「转换技能 frontmatter」：载入 SKILL.md 后，将 when_to_use 等别名映射到 DSH 字段，并生成模型和用户调用策略；不符合所需格式或缺少描述的文件会被跳过。
dsh-skills-bridge 的功能「保留技能附加信息」：生成技能摘要时携带无法映射为 DSH 已知字段的 frontmatter 元数据，并把技能正文和本地路径提供给 DSH 技能目录。
dsh-skills-bridge 的功能「文件变更热刷新」：默认监听技能根目录的文件事件，短暂延迟后使技能目录缓存失效；可通过 watch 配置关闭监听，释放时会清理定时器和 watcher。

dsh-skills-bridge README · dsh-skills-bridge：**Bring your Claude Code skills into [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — zero migration, one plugin.**

[](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[](LICENSE)

*Real session, dsh v0.1.0-rc.8: the agent lists its skill catalog — `pdf-report` arrives from `claude-bridge` (this plugin) with its original `~/.claude/skills/` path, while `using-superpowers` comes from the native filesystem provider.*

dsh-skills-bridge README · dsh-skills-bridge：If you maintain a `~/.claude/skills/` directory, you already own a skill library. This plugin mounts it into DeepSeek Harness as a first-class `SkillProvider` — every `SKILL.md` is discovered, its frontmatter is normalized to the DSH format, and the model can invoke it exactly like a native skill.

dsh-skills-bridge README · dsh-skills-bridge：```text
~/.claude/skills/pdf-report/SKILL.md     ─┐
~/.claude/skills/tiktok-bio-scraper/...   ├─►  dsh-skills-bridge  ─►  ctx.skills  ─►  agent
~/.agents/skills/using-superpowers/       ─┘        (provider: claude-bridge)
```

dsh-skills-bridge README · Why：DeepSeek Harness has an elegant skill system (`ctx.skills`), but its ecosystem is one week old. Claude Code's skill ecosystem is huge — hundreds of community skills, and every power user has a personal `~/.claude/skills` folder. This bridge lets DSH inherit that entire library on day one.

dsh-skills-bridge README · What it handles：| Claude Code frontmatter | Mapped to | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name`, `description` | same | required, same semantics |
| `when_to_use` / `when-to-use` | `whenToUse` | routing guidance for the model |
| `disable-model-invocation` | `invocation.modelInvocable: false` | user-only skills |
| `user-invocable` | `invocation.userInvocable` | command-surface control |
| `allowed-tools`, `license`, custom keys | preserved in `metadata` | never dropped |

dsh-skills-bridge README · What it handles：- **Conflict policy** — bridge skills register at rank `250`: project-local DSH skills (100/200) still win on name collisions; user-level defaults (400/500) yield to the bridge.
- **Hot reload** — optional filesystem watcher invalidates the catalog when you edit a skill.
- **Zero dependencies** — pure `node:fs`, no npm runtime deps.

dsh-skills-bridge README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-skills-bridge
```

That's it — the bundle's patch layer self-registers. Restart your profile and the skills from `~/.claude/skills` and `~/.agents/skills` appear in the catalog (source: `claude-bridge`).

dsh-skills-bridge README · Configuration：Override via your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: skills-bridge
  name: dsh-skills-bridge
  config:
    skillDirs: []              # extra dirs to scan (in addition to defaults)

dsh-skills-bridge README · Verify it works：Ask the agent: *"list every skill in your catalog and its provider source"*. Skills bridged from Claude Code show `claude-bridge` as provider and their original `~/.claude/skills/...` path.

dsh-skills-bridge README · Limitations：- Flat frontmatter only (the subset real-world SKILL.md files use); deeply nested YAML is skipped with a warning, matching native provider behavior.
- Skill *bodies* are passed through verbatim — tool references inside a skill body (e.g. Claude Code's `Read`/`Bash` tools) are the model's business to adapt; DSH exposes its own equivalents.
- The watcher is `fs.watch`-based; on network filesystems set `watch: false`.
